description: Defines the HpackEncoder class for encoding HTTP/2 headers using HPACK compression, including nested classes, methods for encoding header blocks, and configuration options.

classes.name: HpackEncoder
classes.description: Encodes header sets into HPACK format for HTTP/2, manages dynamic table size, and supports incremental encoding via nested ProgressiveEncoder.

classes.name: HpackEncoder::ProgressiveEncoder
classes.description: Abstract class for incremental header encoding, allowing encoding in chunks.

methods.name: EncodeHeaderBlock
methods.description: Encodes a complete header set into a string.

methods.name: EncodeHeaderSet
methods.description: Returns a ProgressiveEncoder for the given header set.

methods.name: EncodeRepresentations
methods.description: Returns a ProgressiveEncoder for a list of header representations.

methods.name: ApplyHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Updates the header table size based on SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE.

methods.name: CurrentHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Returns current header table size setting.

methods.name: SetIndexingPolicy
methods.description: Sets the policy for indexing header name-value pairs.

methods.name: SetHeaderListener
methods.description: Sets a callback for header pair processing.

methods.name: GetDynamicTableSize
methods.description: Returns current size of the dynamic header table.
